name: Character officer supply
outcome: A receiving enterprise can obtain a qualified Academy character and exact animation/context evidence for a vacancy, then independently recognize, induce, grant, or refuse that character under receiver law.
accepts: ActivityStreams Offer<OfficeVacancyDemand> carrying exact OfficerSupplyLot, AcademyOfficerSupplyBid, receiver OfficerSupplyAward, and admitted contract
constitutiveRelation: office + character + receiver recognition + receiver induction = officer
animationLaw: a runtime call animates one character for one bounded act
the call is not the character, office, incumbency, or officer
the model and runtime inherit no character identity or qualification
the character chronicle may admit a witnessed result only through Academy learning law
marketLaw: local necessity selects the officer-supply service category but no provider
the receiver tenders a provider-neutral lot
the Academy discloses recursively contracted capacity in its bid
only the receiver's award admits the Academy to fulfill
award and fulfillment convey no office authority
